Getting Started

How to Book
Your Session

Booking with Ahmed Hassan is simple and personal. From initial contact to your first session, the process is designed to be smooth and transparent.

1

Send Your Enquiry

Fill in the contact form above, message on WhatsApp, or email directly. Tell Ahmed Hassan about your goals and current level.

2

Free 30-Min Consultation

Ahmed Hassan schedules a free consultation to assess your English level, understand your goals, and recommend the best programme.

3

Receive Your Personalised Plan

You'll receive a tailored study plan outlining your programme, session schedule, materials, and milestones.

4

Begin Your Journey

Start your first session and experience the difference that expert, certified, personalised English instruction makes from day one.
